home.about.title: About us
home.about.text: Ljubljana Fencing Club brings together children, young people and adults who love fencing. We train at the Aprima sports hall, Tržaška 132, under licensed coaches who are also international FIE referees. Our competitors fence at national and international events up to European championships, while recreational members find fencing a great workout for body and mind.

equipment.epee.text: Hits are scored with the point only. The whole body is valid target. In a double hit, both fencers score.
equipment.foil.text: Hits are scored with the point only. Only the torso is valid target. In a double hit, the point goes to the fencer with right of way.
equipment.sabre.text: Both thrusts and cuts count. The target is everything above the waist. In a double hit, the point goes to the fencer with right of way.
